You may search and read additional documents inside cyberalchemy-orchestrator and ../domainspec-core when necessary, but for each added source record its path, authority or standing, why it was necessary, and the exact evidence used. Return a source-grounded report to the parent with: sources inspected; added-source justification; extracted formulations; dependency or derivation claims; unresolved ambiguities; and candidate collapse-tests. Every load-bearing statement must cite a path and selector or line. Do not write findings.md.
